## Shipped Projects

### ReadMate — Mobile Office Suite
Document reader and editor for Android. Supports PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB, and more. Features custom document rendering engines. Version 2 adds a full XLSX editor with formulas and a Word editor.
- Platform: Android
- Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.amabytes.alldocumentreader.office.viewer.filereader
- Detail: https://solithx.com/projects

### WOS — Restaurant Operating System
Full-stack restaurant platform built by Hafiz Ali Abdullah for Webticians (webticians.com). The live system runs at onlineorder.pk.
- Client: Webticians — https://webticians.com
- Live system: https://onlineorder.pk
- Admin panel: https://onlineorder.pk/wos/admin
- ePOS terminal: https://onlineorder.pk/epos

- Surfaces: Admin dashboard, customer web, ePOS, order terminals
- Stack: Node.js backend, Flutter mobile, web interfaces
- Developer: Hafiz Ali Abdullah — https://solithx.com
- Detail: https://solithx.com/projects/wos
